lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Training example three. What not to do. Listen for four mistakes. The answers come at the end.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Hi, Mr. Grant! I'm calling about your Medicare benefits. Let's get you into a better plan today.

lines.speaker: Grant
lines.text: Oh. Okay. Do you need my credit card for the premium?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Sure, go ahead and read me the number, and I'll set up autopay.

lines.speaker: Rep
lines.text: Mr. Grant, do you understand that you are enrolling, and do you agree?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: And while I have you, Mr. Grant, I also have a great hospital indemnity plan for just twenty dollars a month.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One. No recording notice, no disclaimers, and no Scope of Appointment, and the opening sounded like a call from Medicare.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Two. The agent asked for a credit card number. Payment information is never collected on this call.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Three. The agent answered the attestation for Mr. Grant. Only the beneficiary or an authorized representative can agree, and he was not sure. The right move is to pause the enrollment.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Four. The agent pitched a hospital indemnity plan that was not on the Scope of Appointment.
